title: Favorite Objects
description: Favorite Objects is a curated selection of works originally presented in the solo exhibition of the same name. The collection investigates the emotional resonance of everyday items, quiet spaces, and sentimental fragments that anchor our memories and intimate experiences. Rather than treating objects as mere still-life subjects, the paintings reframe them as vessels of narrative and human presence. Through textured layers, expressive linework, and a sensitive color palette, each artwork captures the quiet dialogues between space, touch, and nostalgia. Rooted in contemporary figurative art and personal storytelling, Favorite Objects explores how ordinary, cherished items become permanent markers of tenderness, intimacy, and identity.
